data.name: Ghaziya
data.gender_notes: Ghaziya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'ghazī', meaning 'warrior', this name signifies a woman who dedicates her life to the service of God. In Islamic tradition, Ghaziya represents a brave and devoted servant of Allah, striving to uphold His commands and protect His religion. The name Ghaziya carries the meaning “Warrior of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghaziya usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion and courage in the path of God.
data.etymology: Ghaziya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warrior of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghaziya total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
